plainText:
Adventure in the Dark Dimension (Japanese: 探検！！闇の異世界！ Explore!! The Parallel World of Darkness!) is the 26th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
Wicke and an learn Lusamine is on Poni Island with a group of Ultra Beasts.
Unable to get past the Ultra Beasts guarding the island, Wicke and the Employee return to the Aether House, where they tell Gladion and Lillie what they learned.
The Employee reveals Faba managed to take control of the Aether Foundation.
Anabel is revealed to have gone into the Ultra Wormhole at the Poni Altar.
The Trial Captains and island kahunas are revealed to have started training to face the Ultra Beasts.
Wicke and the Employee decide to head back to Aether Foundation to get more information before making the next move.
and are revealed to have ended up at the Ultra Deep Sea and have been separated from Lunala.
The Sun collected are revealed to be able to fuse into its 10% Forme.
Moon's is revealed to have evolved into a .
Sun and Moon change into a new pair of clothes.
Sun and Moon encounter Lunala again, but it is being ridden by Dulse and Zossie, who Sun mistakes for enemies.
